definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that lacks style or looks bad. The opposite of かっこいい.
Describes a situation or behavior that causes embarrassment or loss of face.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧、かっこわるい⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
かっこわるい⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗|の}りたくない→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to ride in an uncool car.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧かっこわるい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that hairstyle is a bit lame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧、かっこわるかった。
examples.english: I fell over, and it was embarrassing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、かっこわるい。
examples.english: Failing in front of people is embarrassing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}れない→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧かっこわるい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: It would be shameful not to keep my promise, so I'll definitely go.

notes:
かっこわるい is an i-adjective meaning uncool, lame, or embarrassing. It describes both physical appearance and situations.

FORMS:
Derived from ⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧. The shortened form かっこわるい is standard in conversation. Also spelled かっこ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧.
- Adverbial: かっこわるく
- Past: かっこわるかった
- Negative: かっこわるく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かっこわるい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: an uncool appearance
- かっこわるい⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show an embarrassing side
- かっこわるい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧だ: I don't want to because it's uncool

SIMILAR WORDS:
Opposite of ⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧ (cool, stylish). Both words are casual and very common in everyday speech.

REGISTER:
Informal. Used mainly in casual speech. More formal alternatives include ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧ (embarrassing) or ⟦{見苦|みぐる}しい→見苦しい：23219_migurushii⟧ (unsightly).
